Off Target: You and your group appear a random distance away from the destination in a random direction. Mishap: Everyone teleports to a random destination.
spells.effect_tr: Siz ve en fazla sekiz istekli yaratık veya tek bir nesneyi aynı düzlemdeki herhangi bir yere ışınlarsınız. Varış noktasına olan aşinalık düzeyinize göre başarı oranı değişir; çok iyi bilinen yerler neredeyse garanti iken bilinmeyen yerler yanlış varışa yol açabilir.

spells.name: whirlwind
spells.effect:
A whirlwind howls down to a point on the ground you specify. The whirlwind is a 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high Cylinder centered on that point. Until the spell ends, you can use your action to move the whirlwind up to 30 feet in any direction along the ground. The whirlwind sucks up any Medium or smaller objects that aren't secured to anything and that aren't worn or carried by anyone.

A creature must make a Dexterity saving throw the first time on a turn that it enters the whirlwind or that the whirlwind enters its space, including when the whirlwind first appears. A creature takes 10d6 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. In addition, a Large or smaller creature that fails the save must succeed on a Strength saving throw or become Restrained in the whirlwind until the spell ends. When a creature starts its turn Restrained by the whirlwind, the creature is pulled 5 feet higher inside it, unless the creature is at the top. A Restrained creature moves with the whirlwind and falls when the spell ends, unless the creature has some means to stay aloft.

A Restrained creature can use an action to make a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC. If successful, the creature is no longer Restrained by the whirlwind and is hurled 3d6 × 10 feet away from it in a random direction.
spells.components_tr: V, M (bir saman sapı)
spells.effect_tr: 10 feet yarıçaplı, 30 feet yüksekliğindeki dönen bir hava sütunu yaratırsınız. Sütun hareket edebilir ve içindeki yaratıklar Dayanıklılık kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olanlar 10d6 kesen hasar alır ve sütunun içine emilir. Bir sonraki turlarında tekrar kurtarma zarı atarak çıkabilirler.

spells.name: abi_dalzims_horrid_wilting
spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of sponge)
spells.effect: You draw the moisture from every creature in a 30-foot cube centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. Constructs and Undead aren't affected, and plants and water elementals make this saving throw with Disadvantage. A creature takes 12d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (küçük bir sünger parçası)
spells.effect_tr: 60 feet yarıçaplı bir küre içindeki tüm yaratıkların nemini emerek 12d8 nekrotik hasar verirsiniz. Başarılı Dayanıklılık kurtarma zarı hasarı yarıya indirir. Su yaratıkları dezavantajla kurtarma zarı atar ve başarısız olursa maksimum hasar alır. Bitkiler ve su bazlı yaratıklar bu büyüden özellikle etkilenir.
spells.upgrade_tr: Büyüyü 9. seviye yuva kullanarak attığınızda hasar 14d8 olur.

spells.name: animal_shapes
spells.effect:
Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. You transform each target into the form of a Large or smaller Beast with a Challenge Rating of 4 or lower. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform affected creatures into new forms.

The transformation lasts for the duration or until the target drops to 0 Hit Points or dies. You can choose a different form for each target. A target's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen Beast, though the target retains its alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target assumes the Hit Points of its new form, and when it reverts to its normal form, the creature returns to the number of Hit Points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 Hit Points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form.
spells.effect_tr: 30 feet içindeki en fazla on istekli yaratığı seçtiğiniz hayvan formuna dönüştürürsünüz. Dönüşüm Yaban Şekli büyüsü gibi işler ancak çok daha büyük veya güçlü formlara izin verir. Konsantrasyon bozulduğunda yaratıklar normal hallerine döner.

spells.name: antimagic_field
spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of powdered iron or iron filings)
spells.effect:
A 10-foot-radius Emanation of antimagic surrounds you. This area is divorced from the magical energy that suffuses the multiverse. Within the Sphere, spells can't be cast, summoned creatures disappear, and even magic items become mundane. Until the spell ends, the Sphere moves with you, centered on you.

Spells and other magical effects, except those created by an artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the Sphere and can't protrude into it. A slot expended to cast a suppressed spell is consumed. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration.

Targeted Effects: Spells and other magical effects, such as Magic Missile and Charm Person, that target a creature or an object in the Sphere have no effect on that target.

Areas of Magic: The area of another spell or magical effect can't extend into the Sphere. If the Sphere overlaps an area of magic, the part of the area that is covered by the Sphere is suppressed.

Spells: Any active spell or other magical effect on a creature or an object in the Sphere is suppressed while the creature or object is in it.

Magic Items: The properties and powers of magic items are suppressed in the Sphere. For example, a +1 longsword in the Sphere functions as a nonmagical longsword. A magic weapon's properties and powers are suppressed if it is used against a target in the Sphere or wielded by an attacker in the Sphere. If a magic weapon or a piece of magic ammunition fully leaves the Sphere (for example, if you fire a magic arrow or throw a magic spear at a target outside the Sphere), the magic of the item ceases to be suppressed as soon as it leaves.

Magical Travel: Teleportation and planar travel fail to work in the Sphere, whether the Sphere is the destination or the departure point for such magical travel. A portal to another location, world, or plane of existence, as well as an opening to an extradimensional space such as that created by the Rope Trick spell, temporarily closes while in the Sphere.

Creatures and Objects: A creature or object summoned or created by magic temporarily winks out of existence in the Sphere. Such a creature instantly reappears once the space the creature occupied is no longer within the Sphere.

Dispel Magic: Spells and magical effects such as Dispel Magic have no effect on the Sphere.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (bir tutam demir tozu veya demir talaşı)
spells.effect_tr: 10 feet yarıçaplı görünmez bir alan yaratırsınız; bu alandaki büyüler ve büyülü etkiler bastırılır. Büyülü nesneler çalışmaz, ışınlanma imkansızdır ve büyüler bu alana giremez veya bu alandan etkileyemez.

spells.name: antipathy_sympathy
spells.components: V, S, M (a lump of alum soaked in vinegar for the antipathy effect or a drop of honey for the sympathy effect)
spells.effect:
As you cast the spell, choose whether it creates antipathy or sympathy, and target one object or creature of your choice that is Huge or smaller within range. Then specify a kind of intelligent creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. A creature of the specified kind must make a Wisdom saving throw as it approaches the target object or creature or comes within 60 feet of it, whichever distance is shorter.

Antipathy: On a failed save, the creature is Frightened while it is within 60 feet of the target or can see it. While Frightened, the creature must use its movement on its turn to get as far away as possible from the target, using the safest route it can take. If the creature moves more than 60 feet from the target and can no longer see it, the creature is no longer Frightened, but the creature becomes Frightened again if it regains sight of the target or comes within 60 feet of it.

Sympathy: On a failed save, the creature is Charmed while it is within 60 feet of the target or can see it. While Charmed, the creature must use its movement on each of its turns to get as close to the target object or creature as possible, using the safest route it can take. When the Charmed creature is within 5 feet of the target, the creature can't willingly move away from it. If the target damages or otherwise harms the Charmed creature, the Charmed creature can make a Wisdom saving throw to end the effect.

Ending the Effect: If a Frightened or Charmed creature ends its turn more than 60 feet away from the target, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is no longer affected by the target.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (antipati etkisi için sirkede ıslatılmış şap parçası veya sempati etkisi için bir damla bal)
spells.effect_tr: Bir nesneyi veya alanı büyülersiniz. Antipati modunda belirlediğiniz yaratık türü alandan uzak durur; Dayanıklılık kurtarma zarı başarısız olursa kaçmak zorunda kalır. Sempati modunda ise belirlediğiniz tür alana yaklaşmak için çekilir.

spells.name: befuddlement
spells.components: V, S, M (a key and a piece of string)
spells.effect:
You blast the mind of a creature you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action. At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats its saving throw. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, the target continues to be unable to cast spells.

The effect can also be ended by the Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish spell.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (bir anahtar ve bir ip parçası)
spells.effect_tr: Hedef Zeka kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olursa Büyüleme büyülerine karşı dezavantaj alır, Zeka kontrolleri dezavantajla yapılır ve 1 dakika boyunca konsantrasyon gerektiren büyüler atılamaz. Her turunda kurtarma zarını yenileyebilir.

spells.name: clone
spells.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 1,000+ GP and at least 1 cubic inch of flesh of the creature that is to be cloned, both of which the spell consumes, and a vessel worth 2,000+ GP that has a sealable lid and is large enough to hold a Medium creature, such as a huge urn, coffin, mud-filled cyst in the ground, or crystal container filled with salt water)
spells.effect:
This spell grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death. This clone forms inside a sealed vessel and grows to full size and maturity after 120 days; you can also choose to have the clone be a younger version of the same creature. It remains inert and endures indefinitely, as long as its vessel remains undisturbed.

At any time after the clone matures, if the original creature dies, its soul transfers to the clone, provided that the soul is free and willing to return. The clone is physically identical to the original and has the same personality, memories, and abilities, but none of the original's equipment. The original creature's physical remains, if they still exist, become inert and can't thereafter be restored to life, since the creature's soul is elsewhere.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (1.000+ AP değerinde bir elmas ve klonlanacak yaratığın en az 1 inç küp eti, her ikisi büyü tarafından tüketilir, ve bir Orta boy yaratığı içine alacak büyüklükte kapağı kilitlenebilir 2.000+ AP değerinde kap)
spells.effect_tr: Bir yaratığın büyüyen bir kopyasını yaratırsınız. Kopya 120 gün içinde olgunlaşır. Orijinal yaratık ölürse ruhu klona aktarılır ve klonun vücudunda tam can puanıyla dirilir. Önceki bedeni yok olur.

spells.name: control_weather
spells.components: V, S, M (burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water)
spells.effect:
You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. Moving to a place where you don't have a clear path to the sky ends the spell early.

When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM based on the climate and season. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.

When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (yanan tütsü ve suda karıştırılmış toprak ve tahta parçaları)
spells.effect_tr: 5 mil yarıçaplı bölgede hava koşullarını değiştirirsiniz. Bulutluluk, yağış yoğunluğu ve rüzgar şiddetini kontrol edersiniz. Her değişiklik 1d4x10 dakika sürer. Büyünün tamamının etkisi gökyüzüne bağlıdır.

spells.name: demiplane
spells.effect:
You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. The door is large enough to allow Medium creatures to pass through unhindered. When opened, the door leads to a demiplane that appears to be an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone. When the spell ends, the door disappears, and any creatures or objects inside the demiplane remain trapped there, as the door is the only entrance or exit.

Each time you cast this spell, you can create a new demiplane, or have the shadowy door connect to a demiplane you created with a previous casting of this spell. Additionally, if you know the nature and contents of a demiplane created by a casting of this spell by another creature, you can have the shadowy door connect to its demiplane instead.
spells.effect_tr: Boş bir odaya açılan boyutsal bir kapı açırsınız. Oda 30 feet kare büyüklüğündedir. Süre boyunca kapı açık kalır. Kapı kapandığında içindekiler sıkışabilir.

spells.name: dominate_monster
spells.effect:
You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target also has the Charmed condition for the duration. Whenever the target takes damage, it makes another Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends.

While the target is Charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action.
spells.effect_tr: Gördüğünüz bir yaratığı zihinsel olarak kontrol altına alırsınız. Hedef Bilgelik kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olursa büyü süresince komutlarınızı yerine getirir. Her hasar aldığında yeniden kurtarma zarı atabilir.

spells.name: earthquake
spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt, a piece of rock, and a lump of clay)
spells.effect:
You create a seismic disturbance at a point on the ground you can see within range. For the duration, an intense tremor rips through the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle centered on that point. Each creature on the ground in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

The spell also creates the following effects:

Fissures: Fissures open throughout the spell's area at the start of your next turn after you cast the spell. A total of 1d6 such fissures open in locations chosen by the DM. Each is 1d10 × 10 feet deep, 10 feet wide, and extends from one edge of the spell's area to the opposite side. A creature standing on a spot where a fissure opens must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature falls in. On a successful save, the creature moves with the fissure's edge as it opens.

Structures: The tremor deals 50 Bludgeoning damage to any structure in contact with the ground in the area when you cast the spell and at the start of each of your turns until the spell ends. If a structure drops to 0 Hit Points, it collapses and might injure nearby creatures.

Concentration: The ground in the spell's area is Difficult Terrain. Any creature that attempts to maintain Concentration on a spell must make a Constitution saving throw. The DC equals 15. On a failed save, the creature's Concentration is broken.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (bir tutam toprak, bir taş parçası ve bir kil parçası)
spells.effect_tr: Seçtiğiniz bir noktada 100 feet yarıçaplı alanda yoğun titreşim yaratırsınız. Zemin zorlu arazi haline gelir, konsantrasyon gerektiren büyülere zorlu Anayasa kurtarma zarı gerekir ve zemin çatlayabilir. Yapılar hasar görebilir.

spells.name: glibness
spells.effect: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates that you are being truthful.
spells.effect_tr: Büyü süresince yalan söylediğinizde büyü yeteneğiniz Karizma kontrolleri için kullanılır ve doğruluğunuzu belirleyen büyüler sizi yalancı olarak gösteremez. Ayrıca Karizma kontrolleri için avantaj kazanırsınız.

spells.name: holy_aura
spells.components: V, S, M (a tiny reliquary worth 1,000+ GP containing a sacred relic, such as a snippet of cloth from a saint's robe or a piece of parchment from a religious text)
spells.effect: Divine light washes out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot Emanation. Creatures of your choice in that area when you cast this spell and creatures of your choice that enter it for the first time on a turn have Advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against them until the spell ends. In addition, when a Fiend or an Undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack, the attacker must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the spell ends.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (bir aziz cüppesinden kumaş parçası veya dini metinden parşömen gibi kutsal kalıntı içeren 1.000+ AP değerinde küçük emanet kabı)
spells.effect_tr: 30 feet içindeki seçtiğiniz yaratıklar kutsal ışıkla kaplanır. Bu yaratıklar tüm kurtarma zarlarına avantaj kazanır, onlara karşı yapılan saldırı atışları dezavantajla yapılır ve şeytani yaratıklar onlara başarılı dokunuş saldırısı yaptığında kör olur.

spells.name: illusory_dragon
spells.effect:
By gathering threads of shadow material from the Shadowfell, you create a Huge shadowy dragon in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The illusion lasts for the spell's duration and occupies its space, as if it were a creature.

When the illusion appears, any of your enemies that can see it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened of it for 1 minute. If a Frightened creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to the illusion, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 60 feet. At any point during its movement, you can cause it to exhale a blast of energy in a 60-foot Cone. When you do so, each creature in the Cone must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 7d6 damage of a type you choose (Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder) on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

The illusion is tangible because of the shadow stuff used to create it, but attacks miss it automatically, it succeeds on all saving throws, and it is immune to all damage and conditions. A creature that uses its action to examine the dragon can determine that it is an illusion by succeeding on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through it and has Advantage on saving throws against its breath.
spells.effect_tr: Yakınızdaki gölgelerden dev bir ejderha yanılsaması oluşturursunuz. Ejderha 40 feet uzunluğundadır. Bonus eylem olarak nefes saldırısı yapabilir; hedefler İstihbarat kurtarma zarı atar, başarısız olanlar 7d6 psişik hasar alır.

spells.name: incendiary_cloud
spells.effect:
A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners and is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

When the cloud appears, each creature in it must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 10d8 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

The cloud moves 10 feet directly away from you in a direction that you choose at the start of each of your turns.
spells.effect_tr: 20 feet yarıçaplı yoğun ve kızgın bir duman bulutu yaratırsınız. Buluta giren her yaratık 10d8 ateş hasarı alır; başarılı Çeviklik kurtarma zarı hasarı yarıya indirir. Bulut her turda rüzgar yönünde 10 feet ilerler.

spells.name: maddening_darkness
spells.components: V, M (a drop of pitch mixed with a drop of mercury)
spells.effect:
Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 60-foot-radius Sphere until the spell ends. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with Darkvision can't see through this darkness. Non-magical light, as well as light created by spells of 8th level or lower, can't illuminate the area.

Shrieks, gibbering, and mad laughter can be heard within the sphere. Whenever a creature starts its turn in the sphere, it must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 8d8 Psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
spells.components_tr: V, M (bir damla zift ve bir damla cıva karışımı)
spells.effect_tr: 60 feet yarıçaplı tam karanlık ve fısıltılarla dolu bir küre yaratırsınız. Her turda alanda başlayan yaratıklar Bilgelik kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olanlar 8d8 psişik hasar alır, başarılı olanlar hasarı yarıya indirir. Karanlık büyüsel ışığı söndürür.

spells.name: maze
spells.effect:
You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze.

The target can use its action to attempt to escape. When it does so, it makes a DC 20 Intelligence check. If it succeeds, it escapes, and the spell ends. The target also escapes if the spell ends.

When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or, if that space is occupied, in the nearest unoccupied space.
spells.effect_tr: Gördüğünüz bir yaratığı boyutlar ötesi labirente gönderirsiniz. Yaratık orada mahsur kalır. Her turunda DC 20 Zeka (Araştırma) kontrolü yaparak çıkmayı deneyebilir. Minotorlar ve Labyrinth yaratıkları otomatik başarı sağlar.

spells.name: mind_blank
spells.effect: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Immunity to Psychic damage, and the target is unaffected by magic that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as Divination spells, and the Charmed condition. This spell even foils Wish spells and spells or effects of similar power used to affect the target's mind or to gain information about the target.
spells.effect_tr: Dokunduğunuz yaratık 24 saat boyunca psişik hasara karşı bağışıklık kazanır, zihin okuma ve büyüye karşı korunur, Büyüleme etkilerine karşı bağışıklık kazanır ve kaderini önceden tahmin eden büyüler tarafından algılanamaz.

spells.name: power_word_stun
spells.effect:
You overwhelm the mind of a creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded. If the target has 150 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Stunned condition. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

The Stunned target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the stunning effect ends.
spells.effect_tr: 150 can puanı veya daha az olan bir yaratığa yönelik sersemletici güç sözü söylersiniz. Hedef sersemler. Her turunda Anayasa kurtarma zarı atarak büyüyü sonlandırabilir.

spells.name: sunburst
spells.components: V, S, M (fire and a piece of sunstone)
spells.effect:
Brilliant sunlight blazes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 12d6 Radiant damage and has the Blinded condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't Blinded by this spell. Undead and Oozes have Disadvantage on this saving throw.

A creature Blinded by this spell makes another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, it is no longer Blinded.

This spell dispels any darkness in its area that was created by a spell.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (ateş ve bir güneş taşı parçası)
spells.effect_tr: 60 feet yarıçaplı parlak ışık ve yakıcı güneş ışınları patlar. Bu alandaki her yaratık Anayasa kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olanlar 12d6 ışıltı hasarı alır ve kör olur. Başarılı olanlar hasarı yarıya indirir. Undead ve ooze türleri dezavantajla kurtarma zarı atar.

spells.name: telepathy
spells.components: V, S, M (a pair of linked silver rings)
spells.effect:
You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature with which you are familiar. The creature can be anywhere on the same plane of existence as you. The spell ends if you or the target are no longer on the same plane.

Until the spell ends, you and the target can instantaneously share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with one another through the link, and the target recognizes you as the creature it is communicating with. The spell enables a creature with an Intelligence score of at least 1 to understand the meaning of your words and take in the scope of any sensory messages you send to it.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (birbiriyle bağlantılı bir çift gümüş yüzük)
spells.effect_tr: Aynı düzlemdeki herhangi bir konumdaki istekli bir yaratıkla telepati bağlantısı kurarsınız. Büyü süresince birbirinizin düşüncelerini iletebilir, dil engeli olmaksızın iletişim kurabilirsiniz.

spells.name: tsunami
spells.effect:
A wall of water springs into existence at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick. The wall lasts for the duration.

When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d10 Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a successful save.

At the start of each of your turns after the wall appears, the wall, along with any creatures in it, moves 50 feet away from you. Any Huge or smaller creature inside the wall or whose space the wall enters when it moves must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 5d10 Bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature can take this damage only once per round. At the end of the turn, the wall's height is reduced by 50 feet, and the damage creatures take from the wall on subsequent rounds is reduced by 1d10. When the wall reaches 0 feet in height, the spell ends.

A creature caught in the wall can move by swimming. Because of the force of the wave, though, the creature must make a successful Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC in order to move at all. If it fails the check, it can't move. A creature that moves out of the area falls to the ground.
spells.effect_tr: 300 feet uzakta büyük su kütlesi yaratırsınız. Su, her turda 50 feet ilerler. Su kütlesine temas eden yaratıklar Güç kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olanlar 6d10 künt hasar alır ve sürüklenir. Dalganın yüksekliği 300 feet'e ulaşabilir.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.components: V, S, M (for each target: one jacinth worth 1,000+ GP and one silver bar worth 100+ GP, consumed)
spells.effect:
You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane. Each target's body is left behind in a state of suspended animation; no aging occurs and it doesn't need food or water.

Your astral body resembles your mortal form in almost every way, replicating your game statistics and possessions. The principal difference is the addition of a silvery cord that extends from between your shoulder blades and trails behind you, fading to invisibility after 1 foot. This cord is your tether to your material body.

While in the Astral Plane, you can use the cord to return to your body — as a bonus action — ending the spell for you and that creature. If your astral form drops to 0 hit points, the cord snaps, and your astral form dissipates; you don't die, but you can't reenter the Astral Plane via this spell for at least 7 days.

If you are killed while in the Astral Plane, your astral body dies and your material body is also slain.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (her hedef için: 1.000+ AP değerinde bir yakıntı taşı ve 100+ AP değerinde bir gümüş külçe, büyü bunları tüketir)
spells.effect_tr: Siz ve en fazla sekiz istekli yaratık astral bedenlerinizi Astral Düzlem'e gönderirsiniz. Fiziksel bedenleriniz büyü bitiğinde veya astral bedeniniz 0 can puanına düşene kadar güvende kalır. Astral düzlemden diğer düzlemlere geçiş yapabilirsiniz.

spells.name: Blade of Disaster
spells.effect:
You create a blade-shaped planar rift about 3 feet long in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The blade lasts for the duration. When you cast this spell, you can make up to two melee spell attacks with the blade, each one against a creature, loose object, or structure within 5 feet of the blade. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 force damage. This attack scores a critical hit if the number on the d20 is 18 or higher. On a critical hit, the blade deals an extra 8d12 force damage (for a total of 12d12 force damage).

As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can move the blade up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see and then make up to two melee spell attacks with it again.
spells.effect_tr: Görüş alanınızdaki bir noktada büyüsel kılıç yaratırsınız. Her turda bonus eylem olarak kılıcı hareket ettirip iki saldırı yaptırabilirsiniz. Her saldırı isabet ederse 2d12 güç hasarı verir ve kritik isabette üçlü hasar zar atılır.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.effect:
You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can't be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Additionally, other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target for the duration.

This spell immediately ends if you cast it again before its duration ends.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (bir sinekkuşu tüyü)
spells.effect_tr: Dokunduğunuz yaratık 8 saat boyunca yakın geleceği hisseder. Etkilenen yaratık saldırı atışlarına, yetenek kontrollerine ve kurtarma zarlarına avantaj kazanır. Buna karşılık ona yapılan saldırı atışları dezavantajla yapılır ve sürpriz durumuna yakalanmaz.

spells.name: Gate
spells.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 5,000+ GP)
spells.effect:
You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. The portal lasts for the duration.

The portal has a front and a back on each plane where it appears. Travel through the portal is possible only by moving through its front. Anything that does so is instantly transported to the other plane, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest to the portal.

Deities and other planar rulers can prevent portals created by this spell from opening in their presence or anywhere within their domains.

When you cast this spell, you can speak the name of a specific creature (a pseudonym, title, or nickname doesn't work). If that creature is on a plane other than the one you are on, the portal opens in the named creature's immediate vicinity and draws the creature through it to the nearest unoccupied space on your side of the portal. You gain no special power over the creature, and it is free to act as the DM deems appropriate. It might leave, attack you, or help you.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (5.000+ AP değerinde bir elmas)
spells.effect_tr: Başka bir varoluş düzlemine açılan portal yaratırsınız. Portal 1 dakika süresince açık kalır. Portaldan geçmek isteyen yaratıklar geçebilir. Ayrıca başka bir düzlemdeki belirli bir varlığı portala çekmeye zorlayabilirsiniz.

spells.name: Imprisonment
spells.components: V, S, M (a vellum depiction or carved statue in the likeness of the target, and a special component worth 500+ GP per Hit Die of the target, which the spell consumes)
spells.effect:
You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be bound by the spell; if it succeeds, it is immune to this spell if you cast it again. While affected by this spell, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Divination spells can't locate or perceive the target.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the following forms of imprisonment:

Burial. The target is entombed far beneath the earth in a sphere of magical force just large enough to contain the target. Nothing can pass through the sphere, nor can any creature teleport or use planar travel to get into or out of it.

Chaining. Heavy chains, firmly rooted in the ground, hold the target in place. The target is restrained until the spell ends, and it can't move or be moved by any means until then.

Hedged Prison. The spell transports the target into a tiny demiplane that is warded against teleportation and planar travel. The demiplane can be a labyrinth, a cage, a tower, or any similar confined structure or area of your choice.

Minimus Containment. The target shrinks to a height of 1 inch and is imprisoned inside a gemstone or similar object. Light can pass through the gemstone normally (allowing the target to see out and other creatures to see in), but nothing else can pass through, even by means of teleportation or planar travel.

Slumber. The target falls asleep and can't be awoken.

To end the spell, a creature must use an action to make an Arcana check (DC 20) or cast Dispel Magic on the target.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (hedefin görüntüsünü içeren parşömen veya oyma heykel ve büyünün tükettiği hedefin her Vuruş Zarı için 500+ AP değerinde özel bileşen)
spells.effect_tr: Gördüğünüz bir yaratığı büyüsel hapishaneye yerleştirirsiniz. Hedef Bilgelik kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olursa seçtiğiniz hapishane türüne göre (zincirleme, küçültülmüş kavanoza, uyku, parçalanma veya gömme) hapsedilir ve büyü sona erdirilene kadar bu halde kalır.

spells.name: Invulnerability
spells.components: V, S, M (a small piece of adamantine worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
spells.effect: You are immune to all damage until the spell ends.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (büyünün tükettiği 500+ AP değerinde küçük bir adamantit parçası)
spells.effect_tr: Büyü süresince tüm hasar türlerine karşı bağışıklık kazanırsınız.

spells.name: Mass Heal
spells.effect: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell are also cured of all diseases and any effect making them blinded or deafened. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
spells.effect_tr: 60 feet içindeki yaratıklar arasında toplam 700 can puanı dağıtırsınız. Her etkilenen yaratık körlük, sağırlık ve hastalıklardan da iyileşir.

spells.name: Mass Polymorph
spells.effect:
You transform up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist the transformation. An unwilling shapechanger automatically succeeds on the save.

Each target assumes a beast form of your choice, and you can choose the same form or different ones for each target. The new form can be any beast you have seen whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's (or half the target's level, if the target doesn't have a challenge rating). The target's game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the chosen beast, except the target retains its hit points.

Each target gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the hit points of its new form. These temporary hit points can't be replaced by temporary hit points from another source. A target reverts to its normal form when it has no more temporary hit points or it dies. If the spell ends before then, the creature loses its temporary hit points and reverts to its normal form.

The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't cast spells, speak, or take any other action that requires hands or speech.

The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (bir tırtıl kozası)
spells.effect_tr: 120 feet içindeki en fazla on yaratığı seçtiğiniz hayvan formuna dönüştürürsünüz. Her hedef Bilgelik kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olanlar dönüşür. Dönüşüm süresince hedefler büyü yeteneklerini kaybeder. Konsantrasyon bozulduğunda geri dönerler.

spells.name: Meteor Swarm
spells.effect:
Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a Dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature takes 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in the area of more than one fiery burst is affected only once.

The spell damages objects in the area and ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.
spells.effect_tr: Gökyüzünden dört parlayan meteor iner ve seçtiğiniz dört noktada 40 feet yarıçaplı alanlarda patlar (en az 40 feet birbirinden uzak). Bu alanlardaki her yaratık Çeviklik kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olanlar 20d6 ateş ve 20d6 künt hasar alır, başarılı olanlar hasarı yarıya indirir.

spells.name: Power Word Heal
spells.effect: A wave of healing energy washes over a creature you can see within range. The target regains all its hit points. If the creature has the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition, the condition ends. If the creature has the Prone condition, it can use its Reaction to stand up.
spells.effect_tr: Dokunduğunuz yaratığın tüm can puanları geri gelir. Ayrıca tüm hastalıklar, körlük, sağırlık ve Büyülenmiş ile Korkmuş durumları sona erer. Yatan yaratık ayağa kalkar.

spells.name: Power Word Kill
spells.effect:
You speak a word of power that overwhelms the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded. If the target has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, it takes 12d12 psychic damage.

A Construct or an Undead is immune to this spell.
spells.effect_tr: 100 can puanı veya daha az olan gördüğünüz bir yaratığa yönelik ölüm sözü söylersiniz. Hedef anında ölür. Kurtarma zarı gerekmez.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall
spells.effect:
A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall — up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick — centered on a point you can see within range. Alternatively, you can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point you choose within range. The wall remains in place for the duration. If you position the wall so that it passes through a space occupied by a creature, the spell fails and your action and the spell slot are wasted.

The wall sheds Bright Light out to 100 feet and Dim Light for an additional 100 feet. You and creatures you designate at the time you cast the spell can pass through and remain near the wall without harm. If another creature that can see the wall moves to within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become Blinded for 1 minute.

The wall consists of seven layers, each with a different color. When a creature attempts to reach into or pass through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the wall's layers. As it passes or reaches through each layer, the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw or be affected by that layer's properties as described in the Prismatic Layers table.
spells.effect_tr: Görüş alanınızdaki bir noktaya 90 feet uzunluğunda ve 30 feet yüksekliğinde yedi renkli parlak duvar yaratırsınız. Her renk farklı bir koruma sağlar ve farklı bir etkiyle geçişi engeller. Duvarı geçmeye çalışan yaratıklar sırayla her renkten etkilenir.

spells.name: Psychic Scream
spells.effect:
You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. Creatures that have an Intelligence score of 2 or lower are unaffected.

Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 psychic damage and is Stunned. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only. If a target is killed by this damage, its head explodes, assuming it has one.

A Stunned target can make an Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the Stunned condition ends.
spells.effect_tr: 90 feet içindeki en fazla on gördüğünüz yaratığın zihinlerine patlayıcı psişik enerji gönderirsiniz. Her hedef Zeka kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olanlar 14d6 psişik hasar alır ve sersemler. Başarılı olanlar hasarı yarıya indirir.

spells.name: Shapechange
spells.components: V, S, M (a jade circlet worth 1,500+ GP, which you must place on your head before casting the spell)
spells.effect:
You assume the form of a different creature for the duration. The new form can be of any creature with a challenge rating equal to your level or lower. The creature can't be a Construct or an Undead, and you must have seen the sort of creature at least once. You transform into an average example of that creature, one without any class levels or the Spellcasting trait.

Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen creature, though you retain your alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your skill and saving throw proficiencies, using your own or the creature's statistics, whichever is higher. You don't retain your class features.

When you transform, you assume the creature's hit points and Hit Dice. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed.

You are limited in the actions you can perform by the nature of your new form. You can't cast spells, speak, or take any action that requires hands or speech unless the creature form is capable of doing so.

You can use your action to revert to your normal form. If you drop to 0 hit points or die while in the new form, you revert to your normal form, and any excess damage carries over to your normal form.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (büyüyü atmadan önce başınıza koymanız gereken 1.500+ AP değerinde yeşim taç)
spells.effect_tr: İstihbarat puanınız 3 veya daha fazla olan herhangi bir yaratık formuna dönüşürsünüz. Orijinal istatistiklerinizi korursunuz ancak yeni formun fiziksel istatistiklerini ve yeteneklerini kazanırsınız. Her turda bonus eylem olarak form değiştirebilirsiniz.

spells.name: Storm of Vengeance
spells.effect:
A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet. Lightning flashes in the area, thunder booms, and strong winds roar. Each creature under the cloud (no more than 5,000 feet beneath the cloud) when it appears must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 Thunder damage and becomes Deafened for 5 minutes.

Each round you maintain concentration on this spell, the storm produces different effects on your turn:

Round 2. Acidic rain falls from the cloud. Each creature and object under the cloud takes 1d6 Acid damage.

Round 3. You call six bolts of lightning from the cloud to strike six creatures or objects of your choice beneath the cloud. A given creature or object can't be struck by more than one bolt. A struck creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 10d6 Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Round 4. Hailstones rain down from the cloud. Each creature under the cloud takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage.

Rounds 5–10. Gusts and freezing rain assail the area under the cloud. The area becomes difficult terrain and is heavily obscured. Each creature there takes 1d6 Cold damage. Ranged weapon attacks in the area are impossible. The wind and rain count as a severe distraction for the purposes of maintaining concentration on spells. Finally, gusts of strong wind (ranging from 20 to 50 miles per hour) automatically disperse fog, mists, and similar phenomena in the area, whether mundane or magical.
spells.effect_tr: 360 feet yarıçaplı dev bir fırtına bulutunu çağırırsınız. Her turda farklı etkiler gerçekleşir: 1. turda gök gürültüsü ve yıldırım, 2. turda asit yağmuru, 3. turda buz parçaları ve soğuk hasar, 4. turda zehirli dolu ve son turda 1d6 yıldırım daha çakar.

spells.name: Time Stop
spells.effect:
You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.

This effect ends if one of the actions you use during this period, or any effects that you create during this period, affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the effect ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast the spell.
spells.effect_tr: Kısa süreliğine zamanı dondurursunuz. 1d4+1 tur boyunca yalnızca siz hareket edersiniz. Diğer yaratıkları veya nesneleri etkileyecek büyü veya eylem kullandığınızda zaman akışı normale döner.

spells.name: True Polymorph
spells.components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke)
spells.effect:
Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range. You transform the creature into a different creature, the creature into an object, or the object into a creature (the object must be neither worn nor carried by another creature). The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. If you concentrate on this spell for the full duration, the transformation lasts until it is dispelled.

Creature into Creature. If you turn a creature into another kind of creature, the new form can be any kind you choose whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's challenge rating or level. The target's game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the new form. It retains its alignment and personality.

Creature into Object. If you turn a creature into an object, it transforms along with whatever it is wearing and carrying into that form, as long as the object's size is no larger than the creature's size. The creature's statistics become those of the object, and the creature has no memory of time spent in this form after the spell ends and it returns to its normal form.

Object into Creature. You can turn an object into any kind of creature, as long as the creature's size is no larger than the object's size. The creature is friendly to you and your companions. It acts on each of your turns. You decide what action it takes and how it moves. The DM has the creature's statistics and resolves all of its actions and movement.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (bir damla cıva, bir parça arap zamkı ve bir tutam duman)
spells.effect_tr: Bir yaratığı veya nesneyi başka bir şeye dönüştürürsünüz. Hedef Bilgelik kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olursa seçilen yaratık veya nesneye dönüşür. Büyü 1 saat konsantrasyon sürdürülürse kalıcı hale gelir.

spells.name: True Resurrection
spells.components: V, S, M (a sprinkle of holy water and diamonds worth 25,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
spells.effect:
You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age. If the creature's soul is free and willing, the creature is restored to life with all its hit points.

This spell neutralizes any poisons and cures diseases that affected the creature at the time it died. This spell closes all mortal wounds and restores any missing body parts. If the creature lacked a body (or was a spirit), the spell forms a new adult body for it.

Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it disappears.
spells.components_tr: V, S, M (kutsal su serpmesi ve büyünün tükettiği 25.000+ AP değerinde elmaslar)
spells.effect_tr: 200 yıl içinde ölmüş olan bir yaratığı diriltirsiniz. Ceset gerekmez; yaratık ismi ve bir zamanlar yaşayan biri olması yeterlidir. Tüm can puanlarıyla geri döner ve tüm yaralanmaları iyileşir.

spells.name: Weird
spells.effect:
You draw on the deepest fears of a group of creatures to create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes Frightened for the duration. The illusion calls on the creature's deepest fears, manifesting its worst nightmares as an implacable threat.

At the end of each of the Frightened creature's turns, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 4d10 Psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends for that creature.
spells.effect_tr: 30 feet yarıçaplı alandaki her yaratığın zihninden en derin korkuyu okuyarak her birine kişiselleştirilmiş korku yanılsaması yaratırsınız. Her hedef Bilgelik kurtarma zarı atar; başarısız olanlar Korkmuş olur ve her turunda 4d10 psişik hasar alır. Her turda kurtarma zarıyla kurtulabilir.

spells.name: Wish
spells.effect:
Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality in accord with your desires.

The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of 8th level or lower. You don't need to meet any requirements in that spell, including costly components. The spell simply takes effect. Alternatively, you can create one of the following effects of your choice:

Object Creation. You create one object of up to 25,000 GP in value that isn't a magic item. The object can be no more than 300 feet in any dimension, and it appears in an unoccupied space you can see on the ground.

Instant Knowledge. You feel brief but certain knowledge of a single fact of your choice. The knowledge comes to you in a flash, but the spell provides no additional insight.

Sudden Learning. You replace one of your feats with another feat for which you qualify. The change is temporary; when you finish your next Long Rest, you revert to your previous feat.

Reshape Reality. You request a reasonable alteration to a fact, and the DM decides how it ripples through reality. The DM might require you to cast this spell again, perhaps multiple times, to fully realize the alteration.

Redo. You undo a single recent event by forcing a reroll of any die roll made within the last round (including your last turn). Reality reshapes itself to accommodate the new result.

The stress of casting this spell weakens you. After enduring that stress, each time you cast a spell until you finish a Long Rest, you take 1d10 Necrotic damage per level of that spell. This damage can't be reduced or prevented in any way. In addition, your Strength drops to 3 (if it isn't 3 or lower already) for 2d4 days. For each of those days that you spend resting and doing nothing more than light activity, your remaining recovery time decreases by 2 days. Finally, there is a 33 percent chance that you are unable to cast Wish ever again if you suffer this stress.
spells.effect_tr: Varoluşun dokusunu yeniden şekillendiren en güçlü büyü. Oyun alanındaki herhangi bir 8. seviye veya daha düşük büyüyü kopyalayabilir ya da DM onayıyla gerçeklik dışı bir isteği yerine getirmeye çalışırsınız. Büyü dışı bir etki talep etmek sizi güçsüz bırakabilir.
